svg.title: The Undead Clock (2025 – 2026)
svg.desc: The Undead Clock, 2025 to 2026: Unreal Engine 5 survival game built in Blueprints.
svg.text: Unreal Engine 5 survival game built entirely in Blueprints: escape a zombie-infested
industrial complex before time or health runs out.
Playable game: nine waves, five doors and a final keypad puzzle.
